integrity: Exact analytic finite-size-to-limit argument; finite code checks are ancillary and not proof of unbounded-size conclusions. No outside validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The limit is finite, but not proved positive or explicitly evaluated; the convergence estimate is not sharp and its constants diverge as t approaches one or the order approaches one. Colorless ground states only.
title: Finite thermodynamic limit of stabilizer Rényi entropy in the high-area Dyck–Fredkin phase
